# gtfs-mcp

FastMCP 3.4 server for downloading, parsing, and querying GTFS (General Transit
Feed Specification) schedule data. FastAPI REST API + 7 MCP tools + React webapp.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Overview, quick start, API docs, ports
- [INSTALL](INSTALL.md): Installation and troubleshooting
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Full LLM reference - tools, endpoints, config
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): Release history

## Key Info

- Backend: `http://127.0.0.1:10913` (FastAPI; MCP at `/mcp`; health at `/health`)
- Frontend: `http://127.0.0.1:10912` (Vite)
- Run: `just dev` (HTTP) or `uv run gtfs-mcp` (stdio)
